recoverable_stratum.definition: 32B-direct right AND 7B greedy wrong -- the only errors a cascade can win
recoverable_stratum.note: compare with 1/K: on a recoverable item the verifier is choosing among the same complete option set, so anything above 1/K is signal and anything below means the verifier is ANTI-correlated with recoverability
